item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus phyag rdzogs dbu ma gsum gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i tshig bshad thar pa bgrod pa'i lam mchog
item.coloph: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus kyi sngon 'gro tshig bshad thar par bgrod pa'i lam mchog 'di ni/ 'dzam gling bla ma sangs rgyas gling pa'i yang spal rgyal ba'i dbang po dpon slob la rtogs pa'i sprin gyi maN Dal phul ba'i dus su/ phran rgan kun grags kyi (kyis) bgyis pa la phag la (lo) zla ba dang po'i tshes la a khod dar rgyas gling du dge'o//
